sources.title: Akamai Form 8-K, November 10, 2026 (convertible senior notes pricing)

event.title: Akamai prices two convertible-note series
event.summary: Akamai priced two series of convertible senior notes in a private offering to qualified institutional buyers.

amounts.label: Convertible Senior Notes due 2028
amounts.quote: On November 9, 2026, Akamai Technologies, Inc. issued a press release announcing that it has priced $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 and $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a private offering to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers.

amounts.label: Convertible Senior Notes due 2031
amounts.quote: On November 9, 2026, Akamai Technologies, Inc. issued a press release announcing that it has priced $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 and $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a private offering to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers.
